evidence.does_not_establish: Completeness for every main or supplementary figure.
evidence.location: Source data section, Source Data (download XLSX) hyperlink
evidence.statement: The official article links the authorized MOESM11 workbook as Source Data.

evidence.does_not_establish: The full Figure 2e population or independence of context estimates.
evidence.location: Revealing inter-allelic and intra-allelic differences; Figure 2c legend
evidence.statement: The both-context HLA-C comparison uses Supplementary Data 5; reported PCC is 0.78, or 0.87 after described outlier removal.

evidence.does_not_establish: A recoverable peptide-to-context mapping or the full 359 values.
evidence.location: Figure 2d/e legend and Revealing inter-allelic and intra-allelic differences
evidence.statement: Figure 2e reports 1094 A, 1354 B, and 359 C peptides; text reports medians 57.8, 59.9, and 53.5 Celsius.

evidence.does_not_establish: Assay context for all 359 C peptides or independently validated fitted curves.
evidence.location: Workflow and Generating thermostability curves; direct Source Data Suppl Fig 3a/b/c headers
evidence.statement: Peak-area arrays by temperature and replicate are inputs to thermal curve fitting, not Tm estimates. Suppl Fig 3c header identifies C1R-A*02:01 context.

evidence.does_not_establish: Historical rounding implementation or new independent observations.
evidence.location: Extracting a thermostability measure from pHLA-specific melt curves; Source Data Suppl Fig 5a/b headers
evidence.statement: Supplementary Figure 5 compares Tm with median peak area at 37 Celsius for A/B ligands.

evidence.does_not_establish: Any numerical conversion between Tm and half-life or independent source measurements.
evidence.location: The kinetic stability of pHLA is closely linked to thermostability; Source Data Suppl Fig 4 header
evidence.statement: The authors separately determine kinetic half-life using time-dependent decay and compare it with thermal Tm in Supplementary Figure 4.

link_verification.verification: exact authorized link and Source Data anchor in official article HTML

scientific_limits: No Figure 2 population is assumed from another plot table.
No synthetic status inferred from zero peak areas.
Tm Celsius and t1/2 remain separate fields.
No curve fitting, source-row curation, training, averaging, or independent measurement inference.
